name: iter6-report
title: Auditron Targeted Remediation Revalidation — CrowdStrike Racing About
summary: The remediation is persisted and deployed to Author, but rendered behavior remains incorrect: Teaser nodes have their intended title/description values yet render the page title, and the internal About anchor still has no active-page state when supplied through the header XF.

matrix.detail: New all-package ZIP exists and changed properties are visible on Author; Windows Maven launcher did not yield a capturable exit/log or fresh Surefire XML
All five title values and four editorial jcr:description values are present on Author nodes
Rendered H2s repeat About Us | CrowdStrike Racing; required headings/body copy occur zero times
About URL is /content/adlc-crowdstrike/us/en/about-us.html and anchor renders
0 aria-current=page in page and XF render

findings.title: Persisted title/description properties are ignored by rendered Teaser model
findings.issue: All seeded nodes now persist title (not jcr:title); editorial nodes persist jcr:description. Author HTML still renders the page title for all Teasers and no required editorial copy.
findings.evidence: Infinity JSON: each node title is correct and editorial description lengths are 430/431/503/469. Rendered H2 extraction repeats About Us | CrowdStrike Racing; We Stop Breaches, Why We Race, APR, Oreca and Performance under pressure all have zero occurrences.
findings.cause: The proxy/Core Teaser v2 runtime contract remains mismatched; changing the stored title property alone does not reach the rendered model.
findings.recommendation: Inspect the installed Core Teaser v2 model/dialog contract and proxy inheritance, then correct the property/delegation configuration. Verify rendered output, not only node JSON.

findings.title: Valid internal About URL still has no active-page state through Experience Fragment
findings.issue: The internal URL now persists and renders as an anchor, but aria-current=page remains absent in both the page and header-XF output.
findings.evidence: Header node stores /content/adlc-crowdstrike/us/en/about-us.html; page has 2 matching hrefs, header XF has 1, and both have 0 aria-current=page.
findings.cause: The header model derives currentPath from the XF inclusion request, not the containing page request.
findings.recommendation: Derive the containing/current page from the XF request context or pass an explicit page context; add a live XF inclusion regression test for active navigation.

blocks.p: This targeted build/deploy was explicitly requested by the user after prior call-budget extensions. The Windows Maven launcher detached without a usable exit/log. Deployment is evidenced by the rebuilt 7,661,172-byte all-package ZIP and the changed Author JCR node values; no fresh Surefire XML was available after clean, so no new unit-test result is claimed.
